model_context: Full fine-tuning of a pretrained multilingual encoder, not from-scratch language-model pretraining.

learning_curve.interpretation: Choose further scale using consistent Dev ranking/abstention improvement and new coverage; 50k/100k are not predetermined success requirements. Three seeds are used for the final main scale.

coverage_rationale: 20k averages500 episodes per training family, including70% select/20% no_match/10% missing or ambiguous intent. Diversity of independent mother tasks matters more than repeated entities or permutations.
existing_throughput_limit: Only16 engineering episodes,97pairs,mean78.25tokens and6.06candidates were measured; no full-corpus training ETA is inferred.
efficiency_change: Replace exhaustive four-pass labeling of every proposal with batched authorship, native preprocessing, one independent compact label pass, programmatic validation, and sampled/uncertain-case secondary review. Retain independent partition owners.

sources.supports: 307M total,110M nonembedding pretrained encoder; not a sample-size law.

InPars-v2 demonstrates domain reranker adaptation using10k synthetic positive and10k negative text pairs per collection; different task/model, no claim that this directly establishes PasteWhat optimum.
Cross-encoder fine tuning with hard negatives and independent reranking evaluation; examples do not determine the optimal PasteWhat sample count.

no_claims: No formal training or Test accuracy yet.
No universal optimal sample count can be derived from parameter count alone.
